title: A merge patch array that replaces a root flow sequence is written as a flow sequence
notes: RFC 7396 replaces the array as a whole. The replaced value keeps its style when that style can hold the new value (docs/edit-semantics.md, The value keeps its style), and a flow sequence holds any list. Members are separated by `, `. The exact bytes rest on a kit convention.

provenance.reference: Differential testing of the oneyaml-python native and pure backends; the pure backend kept the flow style; the native backend rewrote the root as a block sequence (`- 3`).
